recent_posts: The Tunisian dinar stands at 2.921 to the dollar, after fluctuating within a 1.7% band over the past month. Notably, the five independent sources used in setting the fix disagreed by 1.26%, well above the usual 0.29%. #Tunisia $TND

The Peruvian sol trades at 3.373 per dollar, its strongest level in 124 days. The currency is up 1.9% over the past 90 days, while the country's economy showed a slowdown in June due to a drop in fishing and agriculture.

The Jordanian dinar stands steady at 0.709 to the dollar, the same level as a year ago and at the start of the year. The currency has not moved by 0.25% for 891 consecutive days, remaining among the most stable globally. #Jordan $JOD

The Egyptian pound stands at 50.3 to the dollar, after a slight decline of 0.5% over the past week. Despite this, it remains up 1.2% over the past month, while recording a 4.5% decline since the start of the year. #Egypt $EGP
